brief:
Israel has postponed issuing construction contracts for a large settlement in the E1 area of the West Bank, The Guardian reported. The move comes days after the UK imposed sanctions on firms operating in the area, though Israeli officials said the delay is pending a new government.

The E1 settlement is viewed as likely to block territorial contiguity necessary for a viable Palestinian state under a two-state solution framework.
dek: Attorney general says E1 settlement decision should not be taken by caretaker government led by Netanyahu Israel has postponed issuing contracts for the construction of a large settlement on the West Bank seen as likely to render a two-state solution…
title: Israel postpones E1 West Bank settlement construction contracts
